notes.title: My new game 'Youtuber Survivors' is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32020125/12e32804cc3e99a9247f2fa6b31f45ccc48f308f.png[/img]

My new game 'Youtuber Survivors' is available now!


[b]Youtuber Survivors[/b] is a 2D rogue-lite, Beat 'em up style action game where you must team up with various YouTubers such as fitness, piano, and gaming YouTubers to survive. Players can execute combo attacks with a one button controls, and a variety of fun and interesting techniques add to the enjoyment of playing the game.

link :
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098560/Youtuber_Survivors/
